first_broken_edge.movement_contract: The policy selects a logical planar destination. Native PathGenerator, MMAP, MotionMaster, and the movement spline follow terrain. Z is floor evidence only and is never a bot movement command.

terminal_edge.interpretation: PlayerPetData.Active was treated as immutable identity even though ordinary pet dismiss/save can clear it.

hunter_pet_identity.contract: Resolve the live pet number to the exact persisted row; compare stable pet ID, owner, entry, spellbook, autocasts, and receipt hash; exclude mutable Active lifecycle state.

hazard_path_diagnostics.contract: Retain the exact rejected hazard receipt across same-tick movement attempts and publish bound actor, hazard, request, primary resolved endpoint, path/floor proof, clearance delta, and terminal reason without changing movement admission.

terminal_watchdog.contract: Classify an exact cohort action-gate terminal before heartbeat append; require strict manifest proof for clear precedence; preserve cleanup and use no fixed raid success timer.

next_work_unit.purpose: Build the exact reviewed source once and run one autonomous completion-watchdog canary to verify the pet lifecycle repair and capture the decisive hazard-bound planner receipt.
